name: @ezclassify/contracts-monorepo
description: EzClassify public contracts: wire and definition types, JSON schemas, the OpenAPI spec, the conformance corpus, a replay server for it, and a schema-only validator
author: EzClassify, LLC

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ezclassify/types && npm run build -w @ezclassify/schemas && npm run build -w @ezclassify/openapi
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @ezclassify/types --if-present && npm run clean -w @ezclassify/schemas --if-present && npm run clean -w @ezclassify/openapi --if-present
scripts.deps:relock: node -e "const{rmSync}=require('node:fs');for(const path of ['node_modules','package-lock.json'])rmSync(path,{force:true,recursive:true})" && npm install --package-lock-only --include=optional --ignore-scripts --before="$(node -e 'console.log(new Date(Date.now()-7*864e5).toISOString())')" && npm run check:lockfile-portable && npm run check:dependency-age
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p libs/types/tsconfig.contract.json && tsc -p libs/openapi/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/conformance-server/tsconfig.json
